name: Extra Mech Enhancement
body:
Prerequisite(s): Bonded mech* class feature; or Mech Piloting*, Psi-Core Upgrade*, Psicrystal Affinity, Technologist*, manifester level 3rd.

Benefit(s): Choose one Mech Enhancement. Any mech that you are piloting gains that enhancement so long as the mech meets its prerequisites.
